title: The Ow! Sound
kidRule: The 'ow!' sound is spelled OU or OW. OU almost never ends a word, so at the end we write OW, and OW also likes to sit before N or L, as in downtown and towel.
hint: I hear the 'ow!' sound, like when you stub your toe. Two spellings can make it. Think about where the sound sits in the word to pick the right team.
reminder: The 'ow!' sound is spelled O-U or O-W. O-U usually goes in the middle, and O-W goes at the end of a word and often before N or L.

check.question: Why does ALLOW end with OW and not OU?
check.correctAnswer: OU almost never ends a word, so the 'ow!' sound at the end is spelled OW!
distractors: Because OU is only used in long words
Because W always comes after O when a word has a double L
